title: Let's find your gown path
subtitle: Tell me what feels exciting, what feels heavy, and what matters to each of you. I'll turn it into one clear next step.

dashboard.title: Make a decision with Bliss
dashboard.body: Talk through renting, buying off the rack, or ordering custom. Your reasons become the plan—not just another checklist.

intro.title: Start anywhere
intro.body: You don't need a polished answer. A feeling, a budget worry, or a disagreement is enough.
intro.promptCustom: A custom gown feels meaningful, but we're worried about cost and timing.
intro.promptOffrack: We want something special without turning dress shopping into a long project.
intro.promptRent: We care more about ease and flexibility than owning the gown afterward.

composer.privacy: Shared with the two people in this wedding.

decision.contested: Two valid needs are on the table
decision.actions: Prepared for you—never sent without approval
decision.confirmedBody: The next steps now reflect your decision. You can keep talking whenever the choice changes.
decision.keepTalking: Keep talking until this feels shared

feedback.question: Did Bliss represent both of you fairly?
feedback.thanks: Thank you — this helps Bliss get better.

state.error: Bliss couldn't finish that thought. Your message is safe—try again in a moment.

questScoping.genericSubtitle: Choose the feeling first. Bliss will turn it into the few planning steps that actually change.
questScoping.introTitle: Three choices shape this part of the plan
questScoping.introBody: Pick one to start, then tell Bliss why it feels right—or where the two of you differ.
questScoping.leaning: We're leaning toward {choice}. What should we think through together?
questScoping.openBody: Talk through the few choices that change this list. Bliss will keep the reasons and update only the relevant steps.
questScoping.unsupported: This decision companion is not available for this quest yet.

workspace.chaptersBody: Bliss keeps decisions connected across the whole plan.
workspace.resourceBody: Ask for comparisons, examples, tradeoffs, or practical next steps. Nothing becomes part of the plan until you confirm it together.
workspace.permanentThread: This question always returns to the same conversation.
workspace.companionLabel: Bliss · Working with both of you
workspace.introTitle: Let’s settle one real choice at a time.
workspace.introBody: Start with a suggested direction or share what you already have in mind. Bliss will keep both voices visible, bring useful context, and remember why the final choice felt right.
workspace.questionHelpFallback: Share what feels right, what feels uncertain, or where the two of you see this differently.
workspace.otherPlaceholder: A possibility, feeling, concern, or idea that is not shown above…
workspace.prototypeIntroTitle: Let’s choose what belongs in your <story>story.</story>
workspace.prototypeIntroBody: Bliss keeps your separate preferences visible, finds the common ground, and helps you resolve one honest tradeoff at a time.

context.title: Bring useful context
context.prompt: Bring us the most useful context for this decision, without pushing us toward an answer.

compare.title: Compare possibilities
compare.prompt: Help us compare the possibilities for this decision and explain the tradeoffs clearly.

next.title: Prepare the next step
next.prompt: Prepare the smallest useful next step after this decision, but do not take action without our approval.

remember.title: Remember the reason
remember.prompt: Help us name what we will want to remember about making this decision together.

understanding.title: What I understand about both of you
understanding.firstOpen: Your view is still open. Bliss will keep it separate until you share it.
understanding.secondOpen: Your partner’s view is still open. Bliss will not invent an answer for them.
understanding.sharedOpen: Nothing is assumed to be shared until both of you make it clear.

agree.label: Help us agree
agree.prompt: Help us understand where we already agree and what one tradeoff is still open.

questions.label: Prepare useful questions
questions.prompt: What are the few questions that would genuinely help us make this decision?

next.label: What changes next?
next.prompt: Show us what this decision would change in our plan before we confirm it.

dock.title: Decision dock
dock.otherBody: Share the idea you already have in mind
dock.otherBoundary: Bliss keeps this inside this exact decision thread and will not force it into one of the options above.
dock.whyFallback: Bliss will explain the fit only after hearing what matters to both of you.

actions.title: Ready for you
actions.empty: Nothing is waiting on you yet
actions.body: Exact details stay visible and nothing is sent, scheduled, or shared until you approve it.

moment.title: Worth remembering
moment.emptyBody: When a decision becomes meaningful, Bliss will suggest the part of the story worth keeping.

legalLookup.unavailableBody: Bliss has no fresh official-source coverage for this jurisdiction yet, so it will not substitute an estimate. Use the issuing office's current instructions.
